svg.title: AIMScribe complete architecture: implemented and future components
svg.desc: Protocol preparation and canonical-card BM25 retrieval feed one model call and common checks; Improved adds a pre-model applicability preview. Future NER is confirmed before input; future doctor acceptance, prescription drafts and governed feedback connect after output.
svg.text: I = implemented prototype F = future design only Orange = tested optional preview Dashed arrows = future connections
OFFLINE | Protocol preparation and source provenance
INPUT | Patient facts remain available throughout
FUTURE | Clinician workflow and governed feedback
Provenance travels with evidence: source ID + title/version + PDF page -> evidence ID -> card ID -> output references
same patient facts in BOTH modes
No case answers in the index
Maximum 10; same hits in both modes
Groq Qwen 3.8 27B selects card / F / Q IDs
Clinical fields + sources; F facts / Q slots
Full passages are kept in UI / saved records
I | Shared checks in BOTH modes
Schema / retrieved IDs / fact + question refs
Mode, timing; freeze hash for final batch
units and confidence; preserve raw text
Link to run, card + source version
Accepted medicine items; verify all fields
Doctor resolves gaps + signs before use
No automatic truth labels or training
Full source passages stay in canonical cards / retrieved records / UI; the model receives the readable clinical-field projection.
Limited checks are not full clinical validation. Frozen expected answers remain outside prompts and the retrieval index.
